# EDDN JSON Schema fixtures

Copyright (c) 2018, EDDN. All rights reserved.

These four unmodified JSON Schema documents were retrieved on 2026-11-07 from the official [EDCD/EDDN `live` branch](https://github.com/EDCD/EDDN/tree/live/schemas):

- [journal-v1.0.json](https://github.com/EDCD/EDDN/blob/live/schemas/journal-v1.0.json)
- [commodity-v3.0.json](https://github.com/EDCD/EDDN/blob/live/schemas/commodity-v3.0.json)
- [outfitting-v2.0.json](https://github.com/EDCD/EDDN/blob/live/schemas/outfitting-v2.0.json)
- [shipyard-v2.0.json](https://github.com/EDCD/EDDN/blob/live/schemas/shipyard-v2.0.json)

The local `live-` filename prefix only records the source branch. The contents are unchanged. They are used solely for offline conformance checks with synthetic game observations. They contain no real player journals or account information.

EDDN's BSD 3-Clause [LICENSE](LICENSE) is retained here verbatim. No EDMC application/plugin implementation is included in these fixtures.
